remainingUnknowns: Exact preview-panel copy needs a UX pass with real backup files, including very large (near-128 KiB) imports for readability.
Whether single-sync.set Apply fits all merged categories under the per-item quota simultaneously needs a browser-harness check with near-cap lists in every category at once.
Screen-reader announcement order for multi-category summaries needs a manual assistive-technology pass.

semanticChanges.change: Refuse to plan backup objects with version !== 1 (versionless still accepted for old exports); current code ignores version and would half-merge a v2 file.
semanticChanges.regression: Import a version:2 file, assert unsupported-version message and byte-identical storage before/after.

semanticChanges.change: UTF-8 byte accounting for whitelist/blocked-authors/allow quotas; current code uses UTF-16 string length and over-admits multibyte text.
semanticChanges.regression: Import multibyte entries sized between the UTF-16 and UTF-8 budgets; assert tail eviction and a truthful skip count.

semanticChanges.change: Incoming entries that would create a new block-phrase/allow-phrase text collision are skipped with an explicit reason; existing rules on either side are never removed. Current code imports both silently (allow shadows block at match time).
semanticChanges.regression: Import colliding block and allow entries in both directions; assert skip-with-reason, unchanged existing rules, and issue text.

semanticChanges.change: Apply performs one sync.set with all touched keys after a re-read equality check; current code issues up to 8 sequential sets with partial-write exposure. Stale snapshots invalidate and recompute instead of overwriting.
semanticChanges.regression: Two-page test: change a key after preview, assert stale status, recomputed preview, and zero writes from the stale Apply.
